title: machine_translate
description: The contract of the Function named by STAPEL_CMS['MACHINE_TRANSLATE'] (not provided by cms; upstream ask T1 to stapel-translate). Input: a batch of plain texts and the source/target locales. Output ($defs.result): {texts: [string]} of the same length and order. Any other answer is refused (cms answers 503, never an untranslated copy).
